title: Apply for a commercial agent licence under mutual recognition
summary: You can apply for an equivalent commercial agent licence in NSW if you currently hold a licence from another eligible Australian state or territory.
intro:
If you hold a current commercial agent licence issued in another eligible Australian state or territory, you can apply for the equivalent in NSW under mutual recognition.

Commercial agents who have face-to-face contact with customers are known as field agents and must hold a licence to:

Note: If you're only wanting to work in NSW on a temporary basis and your commercial agent licence is from another state or territory (excluding Queensland) you'll need to apply for Automatic Mutual Recognition (AMR).
who_can_apply: Hold a current commercial agent licence issued in another eligible Australian state or territory.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Registration of Equivalent Occupation'
Your current interstate commercial agent licence
Two proof of identity documents (one must include your photo, and both must be the original)

how_to_steps.text: Complete the form and take the required documents to a Service NSW Centre to submit your application.

faqs.q: What is required if I only want to work in NSW temporarily?
faqs.a: If you are only working in NSW temporarily and your licence is from another state or territory (excluding Queensland), you must apply for Automatic Mutual Recognition (AMR).

faqs.q: Who must hold a licence if they have face-to-face contact with customers?
faqs.a: Commercial agents who have face-to-face contact with customers are known as field agents and must hold a licence.

faqs.q: How do I submit my application for mutual recognition?
faqs.a: Complete the form and take the required documents to a Service NSW Centre to submit your application.
